authorities.title: Autodesk MLINESTYLE DXF reference
authorities.relevantRule: MLINESTYLE group 62 is the fill color integer (default 256); element group 62 is the element color integer (default 0).

authorities.title: Autodesk common DXF group codes
authorities.relevantRule: For group 62, 0 means BYBLOCK and 256 means BYLAYER. Group 420 is a 24-bit RGB value; its high byte is always zero.

authorities.title: Autodesk AcCmColor::setColorIndex
authorities.relevantRule: Color index 256 is special and means use the referenced LayerTableRecord color.

interpretation.libdxfrwOutput: The emitted MLINESTYLE group 62 values of 256 encode the source's BYLAYER fill and element colors according to Autodesk's DXF reference. Fresh ASCII and Binary libdxfrw readback preserves the same color indices. No libdxfrw color-writer defect is demonstrated.
interpretation.peerLimit: LibreDWG 0.14 converts the selected output to a different CMC representation and its DXF exporter writes group 62 as 0, with an out-of-range packed CMC value in group 420 on the selected output. Its color readback therefore cannot adjudicate this selected DXF field for this profile.
